services.name: Niagara Helicopter Ride
services.desc: A Niagara Falls helicopter tour is a 12-minute flight (about 9 minutes in the air) over all three falls, the Whirlpool and the rapids, departing from a heliport on Victoria Avenue. It’s not a Queen Tour product on its own - it’s a partner add-on we arrange for guests on tour day, and the price you pay depends entirely on whether you book it yourself online or let your guide handle it. We’ll explain exactly why that matters below. The 10-minute Niagara Helicopters flight is an optional add-on, booked on tour day: CA$175 adult / CA$111 child (3-12), infants free, sold only when flying conditions are good. Available on our Day Tour from Toronto and on the small-group tour from Niagara Falls.

services.name: Niagara City Cruises
services.desc: Niagara City Cruises (Hornblower) is the red-poncho catamaran ride that carries you into the mist at the base of Horseshoe Falls - the closest most visitors ever get to the falls themselves. This guide covers current 2026 prices, how long it actually takes, and how to book it as part of a Queen Tour package from Toronto. Walk-up tickets are CA$47.95 adult / CA$32.95 child (3-12), plus 13% HST. The ride runs about 25 minutes on the water, 45-60 minutes total once you count boarding. It’s included in Queen Tour’s Day Tour from Toronto starting at CA$159 per adult, with skip-the-line boarding and free cancellation up to 24 hours before departure. Coming from Toronto? Our Niagara Falls Day Tour
